justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/UncheckedFilterReader.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/UncheckedFilterReaderTest.java. The class is a thin wrapper over FilterReader: it has one nested Builder, one private constructor, and only 8 public overrides (close, mark, read variants, ready, reset, skip), each just delegating to the superclass through Uncheck with no extra fields or separate responsibilities. The test file exercises the same single concern, confirming it behaves as an unchecked I/O adapter rather than a class that needs splitting.
